title: Managed Backup: activation
content:
For Managed Backup, the activation basis governs contract activation.

## Policy clauses

The contract status is applied.

The contract approval state is approved.

Activate an approved application after provisioning evidence confirms the configured resources; record activation time from the fixed handling clock.

Refuse rejected or pending applications.

Setup is invoiced under lifecycle and bank-return fee rules when setup fee is positive; a waived setup fee creates no charge.

Repeating an activation of an already active contract is a read-only confirmation, not another activation.

## Authoritative evidence

Before contract activation, system records must establish this condition for the proposed action: The contract status is applied.

The evidence identifies Contract reference, Status. Match the action to that evidence by Contract reference; these references identify the same proposed business objects.

The recorded contract state for this action must be applied.

Before contract activation, system records must establish this condition for the proposed action: The contract approval state is approved.

The evidence identifies Contract reference, Contract approval state. Match the action to that evidence by Contract reference; these references identify the same proposed business objects.

The agent changes the approved contract from applied to active.

## Basis Q&A

**What is the stated entry basis?** The contract status is applied.

## Hypothetical case

For a hypothetical already active contract, a repeated activation is a read-only confirmation. It does not create another activation or another activation occurrence.
